title: Tartaria
subtitle: Test your grasp of Tartaria — free-energy civilization, Mud-floods, Tuning Forks, Atmospheric Condensers, Orphan Trains, and the 8th Re-set trajectory.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: Tartaria was not a myth — it was worldwide free-energy excellence murdered by a planned Re-set. Mud-floods buried the bones of that world. Tuning forks turned stone to putty. Domes sang ether. Condensers rode Ley Lines until coal melted them. Giants vaulted by the Smithsonian. Clones on Orphan Trains into empty cities. Sit with what you missed, then return to the Tartaria deep-dive. The Dark Ages and Industrial Revolution were covers. The 8th Re-set still aims 15-minute cages and FEMA asylums. Discard Religion, Finance, and Perceived Knowledge. Remember the old world before the EMF peels the lie.

questions.question: What was Great Tartary, and how did its end actually occur?

options.rationale: Tartaria was world-scale excellence wiped by a planned Re-set; we sit in the 7th cycle toward an 8th.

options.label: B
options.text: A small fishing village that faded slowly through natural economic decline with no Re-set and no global reach.
options.rationale: Great Tartary was a globally distributed advanced civilization terminated by a pre-planned Re-set, not slow natural decline.

options.label: C
options.text: A Freemason brand for coal companies with no free-energy infrastructure and no civilizational architecture.
options.rationale: It was aesthetic and free-energy excellence later dismantled and hidden by parasitic proxies.

options.label: D
options.text: A future project that never existed, invented only by modern internet forums last decade.
options.rationale: Great Tartary existed as a real worldwide civilization erased from modern records by victors.

questions.hint: Global advanced civilization — pre-planned Re-set — seventh cycle now.
